title: Huebsch — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Huebsch.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Built to Endure." Specialty tier. Huebsch is Alliance Laundry Systems commercial brand — the business side of Speed Queen. Built for on-premise laundry (OPL) in hotels, hospitals, and multi-housing. Same commercial DNA as Speed Queen but with business payment systems.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Commercial laundry operations. Multi-housing. Hotels and healthcare.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Huebsch:

• Same Alliance Laundry Systems quality as Speed Queen

• Built for commercial volume — 10,000+ cycles per year

• Payment system integration for multi-housing

• Lowest cost-per-cycle in commercial laundry

• Speed Queen reliability for business applications
